name: Portfolio Sizing
description: Kelly-criterion-with-fractional-multiplier + barbell-allocation portfolio sizing for biotech fund managers. Takes a list of computed DiligenceRecords + analyst conviction scores + fund parameters; returns recommended position weights with rationale per asset. Different audience from single-asset diligence — this is the v2 surface for the biotech fund-manager conversation. Standard compute(record) returns a single-asset Kelly (useful for 'if this were your only asset' framing); the multi-asset endpoint at POST /portfolio takes the full portfolio.
